name: product-discovery
description: Product discovery and design workflows: business ideas, Supersprint discovery cycles, customer research, affinity mapping, code-based EventStorming, desk research, interview planning and simulation, data analysis, PRES prioritization, experiment design, art-directed landing pages, visual direction research, design-system component documentation, and reusable Figma libraries. Production-readiness guides release preparation with an evidence-backed offline HTML checklist.

interface.longDescription: Supersentence helps clarify a business idea through a compact interview and market research, ending with a super sentence, an honest verdict and a next test. Superhero Skills combines discovery and design in one plugin. Supersprint guides a saved discovery cycle with a growing HTML/Mermaid tree, using the included public customer research, affinity mapping, desk research, interview planning, data analysis and experiment-design skills. Product Design builds distinctive landing pages through a guided brief, independent art direction and visual iteration. Interview Simulator lets you practice customer interviews with a fictional persona and receive feedback on your interviewing skills. Build Figma Library turns product documentation, code or existing UI into native tokens and components, with composition examples and checks for reuse across files. PRES Prioritization compares opportunities with sourced Pain, Reach, Evidence and Strategic fit assessments and human review; Supersprint uses it when choosing an opportunity. Visual Direction Research compares real websites in an evidence-based HTML moodboard and develops a detailed study after you choose a direction. Code EventStorming maps current business behavior from source code in an offline HTML board with evidence for each card. Document Design System Components turns screenshots, mockups and visual specifications into reviewed component documentation for designers, with an optional agent implementation package after approval; it does not use Figma. Production Readiness guides technical and nontechnical builders through a local audit and agreed repairs, with one offline HTML report, a preparation percentage and separate release blockers. It does not deploy applications.
defaultPrompt: Help me find and clarify a business idea that fits my experience and constraints.
Research this product decision and challenge my assumptions.
Synthesize these interview transcripts with affinity mapping.
Build a distinctive landing page with a guided brief and independent art direction.
Build a reusable Figma token and component library from this product documentation and verify its handoff.
Research visual directions for my product, build a comparative HTML moodboard, and deepen the direction I select.
Document the design-system components in these visual materials, including variants, tokens, typography, usage and accessibility.
Guide me step by step through preparing this application for production, with a local HTML checklist and agreed fixes.
